item.title: The Sonoma County Fair — Sat Aug 15, 10:00 AM — Sonoma County Fairgrounds
item.description:
A celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun.
The Sonoma County Fair is an annual event that captivates visitors with its vibrant atmosphere and diverse offerings. Held in scenic Sonoma County, California, this fair is a celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun. From thrilling amusement rides and live music performances to engaging exhibits showcasing local produce, crafts, and artwork, the fair offers something for everyone. Attendees can indulge in mouthwatering fair food, participate in thrilling competitions, enjoy live animal exhibits, and explore the region’s rich agricultural heritage. With its charming blend of entertainment and education, the Sonoma County Fair is a must-visit destination that brings joy and excitement to people of all ages.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Sat Aug 15, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, Mamma Mia! follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, Mamma Mia! promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history. Mamma Mia! is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com

item.description: Public Star Parties are the heart of the Robert Ferguson Observatory—your monthly invitation to experience the wonder of the night sky like never before. Whether you’re a lifelong astronomy enthusiast or simply curious about what lies beyond our planet, these gatherings offer something magical for everyone. Each month includes a variety of engaging astronomy presentations led by our expert docents. You’ll hear fascinating stories about the cosmos and the science behind some of the objects you’ll soon be observing. These talks set the stage for an unforgettable night under the stars. Step outside into the darkness of Sugarloaf Ridge State Park, where the skies open up in breathtaking clarity. You’ll have the chance to explore the universe through three of RFO’s massive telescopes, each powerful enough to reveal extraordinary detail: lunar craters, planets, star clusters, glowing nebulae, distant galaxies, and more. item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Aug 16, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.

item.title: Roller Disco Daze — Sun Aug 16, 12:00 PM — Lagoon Island
item.description:
Marin Center presents Roller Disco Daze, a free community roller skating experience on Lagoon Island at the Marin County Fairgrounds. Running Wednesdays through Sundays, July 17 through August 16, the rink is open to all ages and skill levels, with themed nights every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday to keep things lively all summer long.
Skate beneath a disco ball surrounded by the lagoon, then cool down with lawn games, explore art installations by local artists on display, and don't miss the giant inflatable skate for the ultimate photo opp. A DJ spins on-site beginning at 12 pm every Friday-Sunday to keep the music on point and the vibes rolling. Food from Manny's Tacos will be on-site all days of the event, and Lobo's Ice Cream will be available July 17-19 and July 24-26.
Admission is free. Skate rentals, including kids' sizes, are available on-site for $5. All skaters must sign a waiver; skaters under 18 require a parent or guardian signature.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: The Cemetery Club — Sun Aug 16, 3:00 PM — Bay Area Stage Theatre on Broadway
item.description:
Don’t be fooled by the title of this play – it’s a comedy!
Ivan Menchell’s The Cemetery Club is a bittersweet comedy about three Jewish widows in Queens, New York, who meet monthly to visit their husbands' graves. Their routine is upended when one of them begins dating a widower, who, they incidentally, meet at the cemetery. The ensuing drama tests their loyalties, offering a poignant look at love, friendship and moving on.
Starring the 3 Linda’s: Linda Howard, Linda Scaparotti, Linda Baehr, and Laura Martin-Chapin and Scott Slagle.
Seating has been reduced to accommodate “the cemetery” in front of the stage. Reservations are highly recommended.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
This series of short, practical talks is designed to give mothers and caregivers simple, actionable tools to support their financial security, physical health, and mental well-being. Each session is 15 minutes or less and focuses on one key topic participants can immediately put into practice. Topics include: Money for Moms - Understanding Social Security benefits and simple strategies to strengthen future retirement income while raising young children. Stress Relief & Pelvic Stability Through Breathwork - A five-minute breathing routine to reduce stress and support pelvic and postural health. Fighting Anemia & Essential Postpartum Health Checks - Important information on anemia, iron and ferritin levels, Vitamin D, thyroid health, and other key postpartum screenings.

item.title: Wood Street Film Screening — Wed Aug 19, 6:30 PM — Autonomous Gallery
item.description:
A Vallejo screening of the Wood Street documentary.
WOOD STREET follows a year in the life of Oakland’s largest unhoused encampment as its residents face an imminent eviction that threatens to dismantle their community. As notices appear and police move in, residents organize — building barricades, filing lawsuits, and protesting at City Hall to fight for their right to stay. The film places viewers inside the encampment, capturing the urgency, resilience, and emotional toll of collective resistance.
Free, but donations are appreciated

item.title: Local Climate Action: Healing Land, Healing Communities — Fri Aug 21, 10:30 AM — The Backdrop @ Becoming Independent
item.description:
Local Climate Action:
Healing Land, Healing Communities
Los Cien will once again convene community leaders, partners, and advocates for our 5th Climate Justice program, Local Climate Action: Healing Land, Healing Communities, on August 21, 2026, from 10:30 am - 1:00 pm.
We'll open with a blessing from Melissa Elgin, Tribal Council Secretary of the Federated Indians of Graton Rancheria, honoring the land on which we gather. From there, our panel brings together leaders doing this work right here in Sonoma County: Dillon Williams of Hybrid Indigenous Stewardship, Latino Service Providers, and Aura Aguilar of North Bay Jobs With Justice. Together they'll share what they're building and why it matters, from fire resilience rooted in Traditional Ecological Knowledge, to tackling extreme heat in neighborhoods like Roseland, to building worker power for economic, racial, and climate justice.
